findings.message: Full-frame overlay "#f2-front" starts visible before its first GSAP opacity tween at 0.10s. It will cover earlier render frames, often as a blank/white video.
findings.fixHint: Add `opacity: 0` to "#f2-front" in CSS/inline styles, or add an immediate `gsap.set("#f2-front", { opacity: 0 })` (outside the timeline) before the reveal tween.
